import hashlib, importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path
from arcpuzzles.parametric_worker import _real_evaluator, _grid
p=Path('generators/7fe59337a0b4/workspace/parametric')
baseline_path=Path('../checks/7fe59337a0b4/self-review-below-source-v1.json')
baseline=json.loads(baseline_path.read_text())
def hashes():
    return {str(path):hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(p.glob('*')) if path.suffix in ('.py','.rkt','.json')}
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('self_review_repaired_adapter',p/'adapter.py')
a=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(a)
binding=hashes()
result={'schema':'arcpuzzles-private-self-review-repair-v1','task_id':'7fe59337a0b4','seed':17,'finding_path':str(baseline_path),'finding_sha256':hashlib.sha256(baseline_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':binding,'scope':'Focused replay of the retained below-source reversal rival on the repaired three-demo lesson at seed 17 under both settings. No universal identifiability or owner acceptance claim.','episodes':[]}
execute,identity,bridge=_real_evaluator(Path('shared/runtime').resolve());result['racket']=identity
try:
    for old in baseline['episodes']:
        setting=old['settings'];episode=a.generate(17,setting,demos=3,queries=4)
        assert [pair['input'] for pair in episode['test']]==[pair['input'] for pair in old['episode']['test']], 'query inputs changed'
        witnesses=[]
        for i,pair in enumerate(episode['train']):
            actual=_grid(execute(a.program(setting),pair['input']))
            assert actual==pair['output'],'intended label mismatch'
            wrong=_grid(execute(old['rival_program'],pair['input']))
            if actual!=wrong:
                witnesses.append({'demo_index':i,'input':pair['input'],'output':actual,'rival_output':wrong})
        assert witnesses, 'retained rival still fits every demo'
        result['episodes'].append({'settings':setting,'demonstrations':len(episode['train']),'queries':len(episode['test']),'query_inputs_unchanged':True,'refuting_demonstrations':witnesses})
finally:
    bridge.close()
result['source_unchanged']=binding==hashes()
assert result['source_unchanged'],'source drifted during repair replay'
result['status']='repaired_for_retained_rival'
out=Path('../checks/7fe59337a0b4/self-review-below-source-repaired-v1.json');out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'path':str(out),'status':result['status'],'source_unchanged':result['source_unchanged'],'episodes':[{'settings':row['settings'],'query_inputs_unchanged':row['query_inputs_unchanged'],'refuting_demo_indices':[w['demo_index'] for w in row['refuting_demonstrations']]} for row in result['episodes']]}))
